decision_conditions: Given the addition of proposed new front dormer window would have material impact upon the street-scene and would materially differ from the description of the approved scheme with respect to the original decision notice. Hence the proposed variation cannot be varied under Section 73 of the Act. The description of development would be changed which would be against the advice given in National Planning Practice Guidance and contrary to the finding of the Court of Appeal judgement in Finney v Welsh Ministers & Ors (Rev 1) (2019) EWCA CIV 1868 and therefore the application would require a fresh planning application.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr I Stanakzai (Agent) by e-mail on 16/03/26.
description: Variation of condition No. 2 (approved plans) of planning permission ref: P0863.25 dated 04/09/2025 to include dormer to front (Loft conversion with rear dormer and roof lights to front, including change in roof profile and height)
